decisions.basis: Finite model agreement does not supply natural-language fidelity.
decisions.choice: Present exact meanings and all unresolved source-text units, with explicit per-definition losses and decision alternatives.

decisions.basis: The A10 contract explicitly permits an attributable owner review or an explicit pending state; no human review evidence exists for these exact candidate bytes.
decisions.choice: Record the owner-review state as pending with no attributed reviewer decision.

decisions.basis: One broad acceptance flag cannot discharge these distinct obligations.
decisions.choice: Separate acceptance of partial interpretation, full-clause fidelity, source precedence, root/coupling assumptions and semantic admission.

decisions.basis: No actual source or semantic admission will occur without attributable review evidence. Pending review does not prevent authorized reversible analysis.
decisions.choice: Continue ready independent candidate work while these reviews are pending.

sources.selector: Rights, responsibilities and assertions; Exact transition frame
Definition identity and source fidelity; Type and denotation boundaries

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: Actual attributable owner fidelity review for exact bytes, or explicit pending state; no simulated approval and no canonical source mutation.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Present exact candidate clauses, omissions, examples, witnesses and assumptions to semantic owner; record fidelity decisions separately from semantic admission; rejected clauses route to a new candidate iteration.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.

validation.reviewable_check: Actual attributable owner fidelity review for exact bytes, or explicit pending state; no simulated approval and no canonical source mutation.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
